name: Small Boss?
detailed_description:
The story of fantasy and technology colliding

In《Small Boss?》players take on the role of a medieval prince who is transported by enemy wizards using evil magic to a modern city that is out of sync with time. Of course, some medieval evil magical creatures are also transported over. There are no humans in this city, but there are some intelligent life forms. Players must defeat these potential threats and try to find their way back in this city.

Experience rich changes and exhilarating action battles

Players can learn new skills by searching for gems in the city. Of course, there are usually strong enemies near gems, but these skills are a great help in defeating all enemies.

When players engage in combat with these humanoid intelligent organisms, they can try using blocks more often and enjoy the combat pleasure brought by block and execution skills.

There are two weapon systems in the game. Try combining combos and even achieve aerial combat effects. However, even new players can play their own combos and enjoy the fun of the game.

short_description: 《Small Boss?》 is an action adventure game. As a medieval prince, you and some evil creatures were transported to a modern city due to some evil magic, but there was no one inside, only some malicious technological entities. Kill a bloody path among these evil creatures and ultimately escape to life.
